SkillsAir

Hi Tobi,

Yesterday I promised you the real reason SkillsAir costs so little.

Abraham Akinwumi started SkillsAir because he kept seeing two problems side by side.

On one side: talented young Africans who wanted to get into tech, but every good programme was either too expensive or too shallow to get anyone hired.

On the other side: companies who couldn't find enough skilled people to hire.

A true memory.

Same country, same cities, sometimes the same street. The gap wasn't talent. It was access.

So he built SkillsAir to close it: job-ready training that young people can actually afford, with a path to internships once they're certified. The Access Scholarship is how that works in practice. For people who join during a window, it covers most of the fee, and the ₦2,000 a month stays the same until you finish.

You applied for Data Analysis. That's the hard part done. The next step is just to start.

Start for ₦2,000 a month

Imisi, SkillsAir

Questions? Reply to this email, or WhatsApp me on +234 818 212 6524 (Mon–Sat, 9am–6pm).

P.S. The only other cost is an optional certificate, paid separately when you finish and only if you want it. No other fees.

A3|founder-renewal|ab0.subject: What a data analyst actually does all day
A3|founder-renewal|ab0.preheader: And why you don't need to feel "ready" to start.
A3|founder-renewal|ab0.html:
And why you don't need to feel "ready" to start.͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ 
SkillsAir

Hi Tobi,

Data analysts spend the day cleaning spreadsheets, finding patterns and turning them into charts and short reports that help a manager decide something. It suits curious people who like getting to the bottom of things.

Here's the thing most people miss. Nobody starts out feeling ready. The people doing this work today didn't wait until they were confident. They learned one skill, then the next, and the confidence came from doing it.

That's how Data Analysis is built. You start from the basics and follow a guided 12-week plan with weekly goals, about 8 hours a week.

If you can give it 8 hours a week, you can do this.

See my offer

Imisi, SkillsAir

Questions? Reply to this email, or WhatsApp me on +234 818 212 6524 (Mon–Sat, 9am–6pm).

The biggest problem I hear from people who want to get into tech: "I don't know if I'll even like it."

Here's a way to find out this week, for free. Open Google Sheets, paste in your last month of spending, and make a chart of where the money went.

Do it once. If you enjoyed it, even a little, that's your sign. If you hated it, that's useful too, and you've saved yourself months.

Imisi, SkillsAir
Questions? Reply to this email, or WhatsApp me on +234 818 212 6524 (Mon–Sat, 9am–6pm).

P4|founder-renewal|ab0.html:
Four questions to ask before you pay anyone.͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ ͏‌ 
SkillsAir

Hi Tobi,

There are a lot of "tech courses" out there that take people's money and give nothing back. Before you pay anyone, including us, ask these four questions:

  1. Is the company registered? (Search the name on the CAC website.)
  2. Can I see a lesson before I pay?
  3. Do they promise me a job? (If yes, be careful. Nobody can honestly promise that.)
  4. Is there a clear refund policy?

For the record, here are our answers: SKILLS AIR LIMITED, RC 9272398. Yes, every programme has a free preview lesson. No, we don't promise jobs; certified graduates get access to internship openings from partner firms. And yes: a refund within 24 hours of paying, after you've tried at least a chapter or 5 lessons.
